fieldContext.note: Model-based specifications use visual modeling languages (UML, SysML) in a technology-free manner to specify functional policies and processes.

personalNotes: Structural models (Class diagrams, ERDs) specify business policies to be enforced. Behavioral models (Use case diagrams, Activity diagrams, Statecharts) specify processes to be executed.
